subject: microbiology
title: Cholera Toxin, Darting Motility, TCBS and Alkaline Peptone Water

steps.tx: **Cholera toxin** is an AB5 enterotoxin (one A, five B subunits) encoded by CTX phi phage (lysogenic conversion again): B binds GM1 ganglioside on enterocytes, A ADP ribosylates Gs alpha locking adenylate cyclase on, cAMP opens CFTR chloride channels and blocks sodium absorption, isotonic fluid pours into lumen. Toxin coregulated pilus (TCP) colonises first, co regulated by ToxR. The same ToxR regulatory system illustrates how a bacterium changes virulence when it senses bile, temperature and other intestinal signals.
steps.say: Pilus attaches, toxin locks the Gs switch, CFTR floods the gut: cholera in three molecules.

left.title: Toxin mechanics
points: A1 enzyme ADP ribosylates Gs alpha

right.title: Colonisation partners
points: Fresh shed vibrios hyperinfectious (stool genes up)

steps.tx: **Darting motility** (shooting star zigzag of single polar flagellum) on hanging drop or dark field from rice water stool or alkaline peptone growth, inhibited by specific antiserum (immobilisation test heritage), is the fastest presumptive cholera evidence where cultures lag.
steps.say: Darting commas stop when O1 antiserum lands: motility immobilisation in a drop.

left.title: Motility reading
points: Fresh liquid stool or young broth
Dark field or phase contrast best

steps.tx: **TCBS agar** mechanics from the media module deserve toxin level detail: sucrose fermentation by cholerae acidifies bromothymol to yellow, bile and citrate and alkaline pH 8.6 suppress enterics, sodium thiosulfate and iron add H2S reading; Vibrio parahaemolyticus green (sucrose negative) shares the plate.
steps.say: Yellow on alkaline TCBS after peptone enrichment is cholera's bench portrait.

left.title: TCBS recipe logic
points: Bile salts inhibit gram positives and enterics
Colonies 2 to 3 mm yellow (cholerae) in 18 hours

steps.tx: **Alkaline peptone water** (pH 8.4 to 9) enriches vibrios because they outrun most stool flora at alkaline surface pellicle within 6 to 8 hours; longer incubation lets rivals catch up, the enrichment window rule from the culture module with lives attached.
steps.say: Six hours alkaline enrichment, then plate; overnight enrichment betrays the advantage.

nodes.label: Surface pellicle sampled at 6 to 8 hours

steps.tx: **ORS physiology** exploits sodium glucose cotransport (SGLT) untouched by toxin: glucose drags sodium and water back despite secretion, low osmolarity ORS (sodium 75, glucose 75) reducing stool output versus older formula, rice based variants, home fluids when packets absent. This cotransporter saved more lives than any antibiotic class in diarrhoea.
steps.say: Toxin opens chloride out, glucose hauls sodium in; ORS wins by the second door.

right.title: ORS practice
points: Small frequent sips, vomiting not a stop sign
IV when shock or ORS fails
Homemade sugar salt correct mixing taught

steps.tx: **Antibiotics in cholera** (doxycycline single dose adults, azithromycin children and pregnancy, fluoroquinolone where susceptible) shorten duration and shedding about half, reserved moderate severe and hospitalised, resistance shifting by outbreak. They are adjuncts ranked publicly below fluids in every protocol.
steps.say: Antibiotics halve the purge; fluids decide survival. Protocol order matters.

steps.tx: **Toxin detection heritage** (rabbit ileal loop, Y1 adrenal and CHO cell cAMP assays, GM1 ELISA and bead assays, ctx PCR) built enterotoxin science; ETEC LT measured by the same kits, cross curriculum toxin AB5 grammar again. Bench history matters because outbreak laboratories still run GM1 ELISA.
steps.say: GM1 captures the B subunit wherever AB5 toxins are hunted.

right.title: Modern assays
points: ctxAB PCR from isolates and stool

steps.tx: **Hyperinfectivity and household spread** close outbreak craft: freshly shed vibrios in stool transiently upregulate infectivity genes (animal models hundred fold), household contacts within days, water chlorination and safe storage narrow necked containers, funeral feasts historically explosive. Speed of response in first cases prevents second wave.
steps.say: Fresh stool is most infectious; protect household water in the first forty eight hours.

right.title: Household answers
points: Antibiotic prophylaxis not routine (selected contacts policies debate)
